biological_question: Does climatic loss of larval host-resource opportunity during the Last Glacial Maximum leave a detectable legacy in present Lepidoptera spatial genetic differentiation beyond ordinary IBD and the insect's own abiotic climate history?
directional_hypothesis: Edges compatible with a species' recorded host-resource climate today but less compatible at 21 ka BP have greater present post-IBD genetic differentiation.

distinction_from_prior_host_tests.prior: present-day source-target host-resource footprint similarity predicting cross-lineage T_st; qualified null
distinction_from_prior_host_tests.current: within-species historical host-resource opportunity predicting that species' own edge turnover
distinction_from_prior_host_tests.claim: interaction-mediated ecological memory, not cross-lineage host similarity

historical_host_predictor.host_climate_cloud: Q_host_s is the set of standardized 0-BP climate vectors for native WGSRPD3 units of the species' 1-3 frozen accepted host species.
historical_host_predictor.climate_standardization: use mean and population SD across all 0-BP WGSRPD3 unit climate vectors
historical_host_predictor.edge_positions: five deterministic great-circle positions per frozen genetic edge including endpoints
historical_host_predictor.D_host_t: mean over edge positions of Euclidean distance from time-t climate to the nearest vector in Q_host_s
historical_host_predictor.M_host: D_host_LGM - D_host_0BP; larger means the edge geography became more climatically compatible with present host-resource climate after the LGM
historical_host_predictor.self_history_control: Build Q_self_s from 0-BP climate at the insect's own response-blind genetic localities and compute M_self with the identical analog-distance operator.

future_response_if_authorized.response: endpoint-safe post-IBD within-species edge turnover under inherited p-distance and leave-two-localities-out IBD
future_response_if_authorized.primary_statistic: equal-species mean beta_host_s over the confirmatory survivor panel
future_response_if_authorized.edge_count_weighting: no primary weighting of species by edge count

opening_sequence: build the historical host predictor response-blind for all 642 candidates
drop only species with uncomputable frozen external predictor; no backfill; require >=500
split admissible species deterministically 50/50; development genetic response remains permanently closed
qualify predictor information against M_self and D_host_0BP
qualify Type-I and power on synthetic genetic worlds using exact geometry
open confirmatory canonical/noncanonical masks only; drop unsupported species without backfill and repeat information/synthetic gates
only a survivor PASS authorizes one confirmatory nucleotide-identity opening

interpretation.positive: historical larval host-resource opportunity predicts present mitochondrial spatial differentiation beyond ordinary IBD, current host-climate mismatch, and the insect geometry's own abiotic climate memory
interpretation.qualified_null: no general host-memory effect in the qualified recorded-narrow-host Lepidoptera domain

prohibited_claims: exact host occupancy at every modeled LGM location
direct fossil proof of each insect-host interaction
host causation of every genetic break
automatic generalization from mitochondrial COI to nuclear genomic structure
reuse of the opened 326-species codistributed panel as confirmatory evidence
